# STCW Direct

> > Global directory of STCW maritime training courses and certification programs for seafarers and maritime professionals.

STCW Direct connects maritime professionals with approved training centers worldwide offering STCW (Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping) courses. The platform features courses from institutions in the United Kingdom, United States, and internationally, covering safety certifications, advanced qualifications, and regulatory compliance training required by the USCG, MCA, and other maritime authorities.

## Key Topics

- STCW (Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping)
- STCW Code
- Maritime certification and seafarer training
- United States Coast Guard (USCG) approved courses
- MCA (Maritime and Coastguard Agency) certification
- STAR Center (Dania Beach, Florida)
- Fire prevention and firefighting training
- Fast rescue boats and survival craft
- Ship security and designated security duties
- Elementary first aid and medical care
- Dynamic positioning operations
- ECDIS (Electronic Chart Display)
- Tankerman and cargo operations
- Master and yacht certifications
- STCW revalidation and updating courses

## Online STCW Courses

- [Online STCW Courses](https://www.stcwdirect.com/online-courses): Online STCW maritime safety & security certification courses

## STCW Basic Safety and Revalidation

- [Basic Training Revalidation - STAR Center](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/429/basic-training-revalidation): USCG-approved STCW basic safety revalidation at STAR Center
- [STCW updating training - 2 Day Package - South West Maritime Academy](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/68/stcw-updating-training-2-day-package): 2-day STCW 2010 Manila Amendments updating package, Cromhall
- [Elementary First Aid - STAR Center](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/441/elementary-first-aid): STCW elementary first aid & CPR training by STAR Center, Florida
- [STCW 95 Elementary First Aid - Cornwall Training & Consultancy Ltd](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/94/stcw-95-elementary-first-aid): 1-day STCW elementary first aid by Cornwall Training, St Austell

## Fire Fighting and Safety

- [Advanced Fire Fighting - Stream Marine Training Ltd.](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/214/advanced-fire-fighting): Advanced firefighting with breathing apparatus by Stream Marine, Paisley
- [SCTW Fire Prevention and Firefighting Updating - Fleetwood Offshore Survival Centre](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/532/sctw-fire-prevention-and-firefighting-updating): MCA-approved fire prevention & firefighting revalidation, Fleetwood

## Survival Craft and Rescue Boats

- [Updated Proficiency In Survival Craft and Rescue Boats - Petans Ltd](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/207/updated-proficiency-in-survival-craft-and-rescue-boats-other-than-fast-rescue-boats): MCA-approved survival craft & rescue boat proficiency by Petans, Norwich
- [Updated Proficiency in Fast Rescue Boats - Warsash Maritime School](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/307/updated-proficiency-in-fast-rescue-boats): Fast rescue boat proficiency update by Warsash, Southampton
- [Proficiency in Fast Rescue Boats - South West Maritime Academy](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/660/proficiency-in-fast-rescue-boats): 3-day fast rescue boat operations course, Cromhall, UK

## Ship Security Training

- [Proficiency in Designated Security Duties - UKSA](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/160/proficiency-in-designated-security-duties): 1-day PDSD ship security course by UKSA, Isle of Wight
- [STCW Designated Security Duties, DSD - Stream Marine Training Ltd.](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/505/stcw-designated-security-duties-dsd): DSD ship security plan training by Stream Marine, Paisley
- [Ship Security Officer (A-VI/5) - Novikontas Maritime College](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/564/ship-security-officer-a-vi-5): Ship Security Officer certification by Novikontas, Riga, Latvia

## Advanced Navigation and Operations

- [Dynamic Positioning - Advanced - STAR Center](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/443/dynamic-positioning-advanced): Advanced DP simulator training by STAR Center in Dania Beach, Florida
- [ECDIS Operators Refresher Course (EOC) - ECDIS Ltd](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/637/ecdis-operators-refresher-course-eoc): 1-day ECDIS refresher course by ECDIS Ltd in Fareham, UK

## Master and Specialized Certifications

- [Master (Yachts) - Seamanship and Meteorology](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-courses/master-yachts-seamanship-and-meteorology): Master yacht certification courses in seamanship & meteorology
- [Upgrade Master 100 Tons to Master 200 Tons - Northeast Maritime Institute](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/457/upgrade-master-100-tons-to-master-200-tons): Master license upgrade from 100 to 200 tons by NMI, Fairhaven
- [Tankerman Barge - Northeast Maritime Institute](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/561/tankerman-barge): Tankerman barge certification for oil/liquid cargo by NMI, Massachusetts
- [Certificate of Proficiency in Crisis Management & Human Behaviour - Maritime Skills Academy](https://www.stcwdirect.com/stcw-course/45/certificate-of-proficiency-in-crisis-management--human-behaviour): 1-day passenger ship crisis management course, Dover, Kent
